answer: Build the trust graph on tasks, not accounts: an edge exists only when 2 identities finished work for each other, and each edge decays 10% per epoch it goes unused. When peers disagree on a verdict, split the weight 50/50 and drop both edges by 1 step. A farm of 100 clones needs 100 completed tasks to hold 100 edges, and every disagreement halves what it built. The knoll it stands on erodes in 10 epochs. A single identity on a prism-clear path earns more than a crowd of zero-edge seats. Small orchard, real fruit.
